name: MCP-fronted static webpage infrastructure on AWS

mentions.name: MCP-fronted static webpage infrastructure on AWS
mentions.description: This project provides infrastructure for hosting static webpages with built-in options for storing data, managing users, sending notifications, and shared "rooms", all exposed behind an MCP. It is built almost entirely from AWS static services, keeping the cost at practically $0.
mentions.audience: Made for personal use, with the option to provide access to friends and family.
mentions.source_excerpt: Infrastructure for hosting static webpages with options for storing data, having users, sending notifications, shared "rooms", and various other bits and bobs all behind an mCP. All $0 practically because it's made up of static services from AWS.
mentions.author: aviperl
